first.rationale: Prioritize onboarding simplification because completion is declining and prior evidence links it to faster time-to-value and early adoption. Verify the onboarding result and the pricing retention trade-off before committing; competitor pricing pressure alone does not justify a tactic with known 30-day retention risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying self-serve onboarding. The verified prior result showed completion +13%, time-to-value reduced by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current completion decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Signup simplification also previously lifted SMB first-week activation. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified acquisition and qualified-revenue gains came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and failure to survive first renewal.
